nodes.text: P A R T 8 Watching
nodes.zh: 观察

nodes.text: Every screen is a function of committed state: views, watches, agent events and the task graph.
nodes.zh: 每一个界面都是已提交状态的函数：视图、观察流、智能体事件和任务图。

nodes.text: 8 . 1 Chord and document state
nodes.zh: 8.1 Chord 与文档状态

nodes.text: An observer sees a document as a series of read-only values, each with the exact edits that produced it, and never sees anything storage does not hold.
nodes.zh: 观察者看到的是一个文档的一连串只读值，每个值都带着产生它的确切编辑，而且绝不会看到存储里没有的东西。

nodes.text: A panel that shows a document must stay in step with it. When a tool updates a task list, the panel should change. After a crash, it should show exactly what was committed. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. Pi Durable gives observers only committed changes: each one is a new read-only value plus the short list of edits that produced it. After this section you can attach a document to a UI and say what it shows when the document is retired, migrated, or the process dies.
nodes.zh: 展示文档的面板必须与文档保持同步。当工具更新任务列表时，面板就该跟着变。崩溃之后，它显示的正是已提交的内容。提交是一次原子保存：其中的一切要么一起存储，要么都不存。Pi Durable 只把已提交的变更交给观察者：每一次变更都是一个新的只读值，加上产生它的那份简短编辑清单。读完本节，你就能把一个文档接到界面上，并说清当文档被退役、被迁移或进程死亡时它会显示什么。

nodes.text: What an observer receives
nodes.zh: 观察者收到什么

nodes.text: Documents are built on Chord (@earendil-works/chord), a small library for replicated JSON state. You need two of its ideas to observe a document (bases and deltas (p. 56)): Revision — an immutable JSON value. Every commit that changes the document produces a new one. Operations — the exact edits from one revision to the next, written as small tuples. A copy elsewhere applies them to stay in step. Observers only read. Pi Durable is the only writer, and an observed state has no methods that change it spec §9.1. Each operation is a tuple: a one-letter name, then a path of keys and array indices into the value.
nodes.zh: 文档构建在 Chord（`@earendil-works/chord`）之上，这是一个用于复制式 JSON 状态的小库。要观察一个文档，你需要它的两个概念（基线与增量（p. 56））：Revision（修订）—— 一个不可变的 JSON 值，每次改变文档的提交都会产生一个新的。Operations（操作）—— 从一个修订到下一个修订的确切编辑，写成小元组；另一处的副本应用它们即可保持同步。观察者只读。Pi Durable 是唯一的写入者，被观察的状态没有任何能修改它的方法 spec §9.1。每个操作都是一个元组：一个单字母名称，然后是通往该值的键与数组下标构成的路径。

cells: ["r", value] Replace the whole value
["s", path, value] Set a property or array element
["d", path] Delete a property or array element
["a", path, text] Append to a string
["t", path, count] Remove count UTF-16 code units from a string’s front
["p", path, index, remove, items] Splice an array
["m", path, permutation] Reorder an array: new[i] = old[permutation[i]]
From research/pi/packages/chord/src/delta/README.md. The same change can be written with different tuples, and a large edit may arrive as one s or r. Only the
resulting value is guaranteed.

nodes.text: Two ways to observe one document
nodes.zh: 观察一个文档的两种方式

nodes.text: WATCHDOC() A read-only state you subscribe to. It starts with the current value and calls your listener after each commit. Use it to drive a UI. A stream of frames, one per commit: the new value, its operations and the commit’s Context. Your callback handles one frame at a time. Use it to forward changes in order (the watch contract (p. 129)).
nodes.zh: `watchDoc()`：一个供你订阅的只读状态。它以当前值开始，并在每次提交之后调用你的监听器。用它驱动界面。帧流：每次提交一帧，包含新值、它的操作以及该提交的 Context；你的回调每次处理一帧。用它按序转发变更（观察契约（p. 129））。

nodes.text: Both take the same arguments as snapshot(), and two rules hold for both. Observing never creates: an absent document returns undefined; only tx.doc() creates one (access and creation (p. 53)). And an observer follows one incarnation, the stored copy it attached to. If that document is retired and created again, the observer does not follow it.
nodes.zh: 两者接受的参数与 `snapshot()` 相同，并且有两条规则同时成立。其一是观察从不创建：文档不存在时返回 `undefined`，只有 `tx.doc()` 会创建（访问与创建（p. 53））。其二是观察者只跟随一个化身，也就是它当初附着的那份存储副本；如果该文档被退役后重新创建，观察者不会跟过去。

Step 1 runs on the Session’s mutation line, so no commit can slip between the first value and the attachment; subscribe() then delivers that value at once as hydrate 0. nodes.text: This is the book’s core rule seen from the read side. Nothing reaches an observer until storage holds the commit. Your listener runs in a microtask after the commit’s work on the line, before commit() resolves. Only the asynchronous part of a listener runs off the line: a slow synchronous listener does delay the next commit, so hand long work to a promise spec §1. Attaching waits behind earlier commits, so the first value already includes all of them. You never receive operations for a revision you have not seen spec §9.1.
nodes.zh: 这就是本书的核心规则从读取一侧看到的样子：在存储持有某次提交之前，没有任何东西会到达观察者。你的监听器在该提交在线上的工作之后的一个微任务中运行，在 `commit()` 兑现之前。只有监听器中异步的那部分会离线运行——一个缓慢的同步监听器确实会拖慢下一次提交，所以把长活儿交给一个 promise spec §1。附着会排在更早的提交之后，因此首个值已经包含了它们全部。你绝不会收到尚未见过的修订的操作 spec §9.1。

nodes.text: Revisions are immutable and shared
nodes.zh: 修订不可变且共享

nodes.text: Each value you receive is a revision the Session will never change. Parts a commit did not touch are shared with the previous revision, not copied. In the capture behind the next figure, changing the title produced a new root, but V2.cards is the same array object as V1.cards.
nodes.zh: 你收到的每个值都是 Session 永远不会改变的修订。某次提交没碰到的部分是与上一个修订共享的，不是复制的。在下一图背后的捕获中，改标题产生了一个新的根，但 `V2.cards` 与 `V1.cards` 是同一个数组对象。

nodes.text: Each commit yields a new immutable revision and the exact operations that produced it. A session-scoped app.board observed through documentState() and watchDoc() at once; 101 further commits come before the retirement. Values, operations, sequences and the sharing check are from research/capture/extra-p8/doc-observation.txt.
nodes.zh: 每次提交都产生一个新的不可变修订，以及产生它的确切操作。一个以 Session 为作用域的 `app.board`，同时通过 `documentState()` 和 `watchDoc()` 被观察；退役之前还有 101 次提交。值、操作、序列以及共享性检查均来自 `research/capture/extra-p8/doc-observation.txt`。

nodes.text: Sharing makes publication cheap, but nothing is frozen. If your code mutates a value it received, it silently corrupts the Session’s copy and every other observer’s. Copy first when you need to edit spec §12. To keep a copy in another process, start from the first value and apply each batch of operations in order with Chord’s applyImmutable(value, ops). The test suite checks that this rebuilds every delivered value test/session-watches.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 共享让发布变得廉价，但没有任何东西被冻结。如果你的代码改动了收到的值，它会悄悄破坏 Session 的副本以及其他每个观察者的副本。需要编辑时先复制 spec §12。要在另一个进程里保留一份副本，就从首个值出发，用 Chord 的 `applyImmutable(value, ops)` 按序应用每一批操作。测试套件会检查这能重建每个投递过的值 `test/session-watches.test.ts`。

nodes.text: Retirement, versions, close and crashes
nodes.zh: 退役、版本、关闭与崩溃

nodes.text: Retired — the last frame is [["r", null]]. A state then reads null, never stale data. A watch delivers that frame and ends with reason retired. To see a recreated document, attach again. New version — when a commit stores the document under a different definition version, the observer receives the whole new value as ["r", value] instead of operations on a shape it does not have src/session/session.ts. Session close — every state and watch ends. A state keeps its last value spec §2.2. Crash — states and watches live in memory and die with the process. After reopening, attach again; the new state starts from what was committed spec §9.1. A UI never loses anything it displayed in a crash, because it only ever displayed committed data. Progress since the last successful commit can vanish. The default 100 ms minimum interval does not bound that loss (the live document (p. 88)).
nodes.zh: 退役 —— 最后一帧是 `[["r", null]]`。此时状态读到的是 `null`，绝不会读到过期数据。观察流会投递这一帧，并以 `retired` 为 reason 结束；要看到重新创建的文档，请再次附着。新版本 —— 当一次提交以不同的定义版本存储该文档时，观察者收到的是整个新值，形如 `["r", value]`，而不是对它并不具备的形状施加操作 `src/session/session.ts`。Session 关闭 —— 每个状态和观察流都结束，状态保留它最后的值 spec §2.2。崩溃 —— 状态和观察流活在内存里，随进程一同死亡；重新打开之后请再次附着，新状态从已提交的内容开始 spec §9.1。界面在崩溃中不会丢失它显示过的任何东西，因为它显示的始终只是已提交的数据；不过自上次成功提交以来的进度可能消失，而默认的 100 ms 最小间隔并不限制这种丢失（实时文档（p. 88））。

nodes.text: Drive a UI from documentState(). It shows only committed data, so it is correct after a crash without extra work. Never mutate a value you received. Copy it first. Treat ["r", …] as “replace everything”. It arrives on retirement, version change and overflow. Attach again after a retirement or a reopen; observers never move to a new incarnation. To serve remote clients through a Chord service, follow docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md.
nodes.zh: 用 `documentState()` 驱动界面。它只显示已提交的数据，因此崩溃之后无需额外工作就是正确的。绝不要改动你收到的值，先复制。把 `["r", …]` 视为「全部替换」——它会在退役、版本变更和溢出时到达。退役或重新打开之后请再次附着；观察者绝不会迁移到新的化身。要通过 Chord 服务为远程客户端服务，请遵循 `docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md`。

nodes.text: 8 . 2 The conversation view and watch()
nodes.zh: 8.2 会话视图与 `watch()`

nodes.text: One value holds a conversation’s transcript and what is running now; it changes only when a commit lands, and you can read it as a state or as a
nodes.zh: 一个值同时承载某个会话的记录（transcript）和当前正在运行的东西；它只在提交落地时改变，而你可以把它读作一个状态，

nodes.text: stream of frames.
nodes.zh: 或者一帧帧的流。

nodes.text: A chat UI needs two things: the transcript, and what is happening right now, such as a model streaming text or a tool printing output. The conversation view puts both in one read-only value that changes only when a commit lands. After this section you can render it, keep a remote copy in step, and predict what a slow or late client sees.
nodes.zh: 聊天界面需要两样东西：记录，以及此刻正在发生的事，比如模型正在流式输出文本，或某个工具正在打印输出。会话视图把两者放进同一个只读值，只在提交落地时才改变。读完本节，你就能渲染它、让远程副本与之同步，并预测一个缓慢或迟到的客户端会看到什么。

nodes.text: What the view holds
nodes.zh: 视图承载什么

nodes.text: The view is a plain bundle of stored data: nothing is computed or filtered. This is the view of the capture’s conversation before its run began.
nodes.zh: 视图就是存储数据的一个普通集合，没有任何计算或过滤。这是捕获中那个会话在运行开始之前的视图。

nodes.text: watch.value at attachment research/capture/watch-ops.txt JSON
nodes.zh: `watch.value`（附着时）。`research/capture/watch-ops.txt` JSON

nodes.text: Each document is folded onto one line. pi.live is {} because nothing runs yet.
nodes.zh: 每个文档被折叠到一行。`pi.live` 是 `{}`，因为还没有任何东西在运行。

nodes.text: conversation — the conversation record, with its parent and owner when it has them (records and IDs (p. 25)). entries — the active transcript as stored: the newest head marker, then the non-head entries from its head target through the current tail. These are records, not the model’s context (from transcript to model context (p. 40)). docs — the five built-in documents, keyed by kind (the built-in documents (p. 60)). An absent document is an absent key. These kinds and their fields are public protocol. Your own document kinds are not in the view; observe them with documentState() spec §9.3.
nodes.zh: `conversation` —— 会话记录，若有父级和所有者则带上它们（记录与 ID（p. 25））。`entries` —— 按存储形式给出的活动记录：最新的头指针标记，然后是从其头目标到当前尾部的所有非头指针条目；这些是记录，不是模型的上下文（从记录到模型上下文（p. 40））。`docs` —— 五个内置文档，按 kind 为键（内置文档（p. 60））；文档不存在就表现为该键不存在。这些 kind 及其字段是公开协议。你自己的文档 kind 不在视图里，要用 `documentState()` 观察它们 spec §9.3。

nodes.text: How the view changes
nodes.zh: 视图如何变化

nodes.text: The Harness keeps one shared view per conversation. It is built from storage on first use and dropped when its last observer leaves src/harness/view.ts. Every commit that touches the conversation produces one frame: a batch of operations that turns the old view into the new one.
nodes.zh: Harness 为每个会话维护一个共享视图。它在首次使用时从存储构建，并在最后一个观察者离开时被丢弃 `src/harness/view.ts`。每次触及该会话的提交都产生一帧：一批把旧视图变成新视图的操作。

nodes.text: Two ways to consume it
nodes.zh: 消费它的两种方式

nodes.text: VIEWSTATE() WATCH() A Chord state, like documentState(). Use it in the same process when you only want the latest value, for example a terminal UI that re-renders on each update. A stream of frames. Use it to keep a copy across a process boundary: send watch.value once, then each frame’s operations in order. The other side applies them with applyImmutable().
nodes.zh: `viewState()`：一个 Chord 状态，和 `documentState()` 一样。当在同一进程中只需要最新值时用它，例如每次更新都重绘的终端界面。`watch()`：帧流。用它在跨进程边界处保留一份副本——先发送一次 `watch.value`，此后按序发送每帧的操作，另一侧用 `applyImmutable()` 应用它们。

nodes.text: On reconnect, start a new watch and send its value again. Example 19 with --ops prints exactly this stream: the view first, then one line of operations per commit. The watch contract watch(), watchDoc() and watchTaskGraph() all return a WatchHandle with the same five rules. 1. Read watch.value first. It holds the starting value. Frames committed before start() wait in a buffer. 2. Call start(listener) once. It never calls the listener synchronously. A second start(), or one after the watch ended,
nodes.zh: 重连时，启动一个新的观察流并再次发送它的值。示例 19 加 `--ops` 打印的正是这样的流：先是视图，然后每次提交一行操作。观察契约——`watch()`、`watchDoc()` 和 `watchTaskGraph()` 都返回一个 `WatchHandle`，遵循同样五条规则。1. 先读 `watch.value`，它保存起始值；在 `start()` 之前提交的帧会在缓冲区里等待。2. 只调用一次 `start(listener)`，它绝不会同步调用监听器；第二次调用 `start()`，或在该观察流已结束之后调用，

nodes.text: throws.
nodes.zh: 都会抛错。

nodes.text: 3. One callback at a time. Each receives (value, ops, context). The next starts after your promise settles. Commits never
nodes.zh: 3. 同一时刻只有一个回调。每个回调收到 `(value, ops, context)`，下一个要等你的 promise 兑现后才开始。提交绝不

nodes.text: wait for you.
nodes.zh: 等待你。

nodes.text: 4. The context is the commit’s, without its abort signal. Work your listener starts is yours to abort. 5. stop() is safe to repeat. It drops pending frames and returns how the watch ended. A callback already running is not

nodes.text: Slow and late consumers
nodes.zh: 缓慢与迟到的消费者

nodes.text: A watch never makes commits wait. If your listener falls more than 100 frames behind, the waiting frames are thrown away and replaced by one frame holding the newest value.
nodes.zh: 观察流从不让提交等待。如果你的监听器落后超过 100 帧，等待中的帧会被丢弃，换成一帧持有最新值的帧。

nodes.text: A watch keeps 100 undelivered frames; the next commit replaces them all with the newest value. The frame being delivered is never replaced. Rule from spec §9.2 and src/session/observation.ts. A test commits 101 entries before start() and receives one frame, [["r", view]], holding all 101 entries.
nodes.zh: 一个观察流保留 100 个未投递的帧；下一次提交会用最新值把它们全部替换掉。正在投递的那个帧永远不会被替换。规则出自 spec §9.2 和 `src/session/observation.ts`。一个测试在 `start()` 之前提交 101 个条目，收到的只有一帧 `[["r", view]]`，其中包含全部 101 个条目。

nodes.text: The replacement is [["r", newest]], so code that applies operations needs no special case. The cost is that some intermediate states are never delivered. A watch shows where things ended up, not every step. If you need every transition, record each one as an entry or in a document. For the outcome of one input, use Submission.wait() (submissions and the inbox (p. 84)).
nodes.zh: 替换用的是 `[["r", newest]]`，所以应用操作的代码不需要特殊处理。代价是某些中间状态永远不会被投递：观察流展示的是事情最终停在哪里，而不是每一步。如果你需要每一次转变，就把每一次都记录为条目或写进文档；要获取某一次输入的结果，用 `Submission.wait()`（提交项与收件箱（p. 84））。

nodes.text: 8 . 3 Agent events
nodes.zh: 8.3 智能体事件

nodes.text: An experimental adapter turns each commit into one batch of coding-agent events: a snapshot is the state, and every batch is a change to it.
nodes.zh: 一个实验性适配器把每次提交变成一批编码智能体事件：快照即状态，而每一批都是对状态的一次变更。

nodes.text: You may already have code that reads the coding agent’s events, such as message_start and tool_execution_update: a JSON log, a CLI, a UI. watchEvents() produces those events from Pi Durable’s commits. After this section you can consume the stream, rebuild streamed text from its deltas, and know which steps it may skip.
nodes.zh: 你可能已经有读取编码智能体事件的代码，比如 `message_start` 和 `tool_execution_update`：一份 JSON 日志、一个 CLI、一个界面。`watchEvents()` 从 Pi Durable 的提交中产生这些事件。读完本节，你就能消费这条流、从增量重建流式文本，并知道它可能跳过哪些步骤。

nodes.text: Attaching
nodes.zh: 附着

nodes.text: watchEvents(harness, conversationId, context) is exported from the package root and marked experimental: its protocol may change. It returns a stream with a snapshot (the starting state), start(listener), stop() and closed. It follows the watch rules of 8.2 (p. 129): one batch at a time, and commits never wait src/harness/events.ts. The snapshot holds the conversation’s entries, running tools, compactions, inbox, agent and usage. While a run is in flight it also holds run and generation, the streaming message or a retry wait research/capture/agent-events.txt. An event is emitted only after the commit that makes it true spec §9.4. The stream covers one conversation. A subagent’s work shows up only as the parent’s tool call; attach a second stream to the child conversation to see inside it (subagents (p. 121)).
nodes.zh: `watchEvents(harness, conversationId, context)` 从包根导出，并标记为实验性：它的协议可能变化。它返回一条流，带有快照（起始状态）、`start(listener)`、`stop()` 和 `closed`。它遵循 8.2（p. 129）中的观察规则：同一时刻一批，提交绝不等待 `src/harness/events.ts`。快照承载该会话的条目、运行中的工具、压缩、收件箱、agent 和 usage；运行进行中时还承载 run 和 generation、流式消息或一次重试等待 `research/capture/agent-events.txt`。一个事件只在其对应提交使其成立之后才发出 spec §9.4。这条流只覆盖一个会话——子智能体的工作只表现为父级的工具调用，要看到它内部请对子会话再附着一条流（子智能体（p. 121））。

nodes.text: One commit, one batch
nodes.zh: 一次提交，一批事件

nodes.text: Each commit produces at most one batch of events. The table follows one turn of the capture: the model thinks, calls count {n: 3}, then answers. A generation is one model call, run as a task.
nodes.zh: 每次提交最多产生一批事件。下表跟随捕获中的一次轮次：模型思考、调用 `count {n: 3}`，然后作答。一次生成就是一次模型调用，以任务的方式运行。

nodes.text: Commits 3 and 16 produce no batch: starting an attempt changes nothing an event describes. The tool’s start waits for commit 9, when the call actually runs. In commit 15 one generation ends and the next begins, so turn_end and turn_start share a batch. Inside a batch the order is fixed and matches the coding agent. Progress comes first, then new entries, then ends, and beginnings come last. So a tool’s end comes right before its result message, and a finished run ends before the next one starts.
nodes.zh: 第 3 次和第 16 次提交不产生任何批次：开始一次尝试并没有改变任何事件所描述的东西。工具的开始要等到第 9 次提交，也就是调用真正运行时才发出。在第 15 次提交里，一次生成结束、另一次开始，因此 `turn_end` 和 `turn_start` 共处一批。批次内部的顺序是固定的，且与编码智能体一致：先是进展，然后是新条目，然后是结束，开头放在最后——所以一个工具的结束紧挨在它的结果消息之前，而一个已完成的运行会在下一个开始之前结束。

nodes.zh: 一批之内，先是进展，然后是条目，然后是结束，开头放在最后。右图：测试所期望的那一批，来自一次提交——它结束了一个运行，并把排队的后续任务作为下一个运行启动（`test/harness-events.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: What each event means
nodes.zh: 每个事件的含义

nodes.text: Every message_start gets a message_end, even when a run is aborted mid-stream. A partial is committed only once it has content, and every built-in path that clears it also appends the finished entry. The same holds across a crash: on reopen, generation turns a leftover partial into an aborted pi.assistant entry (generation (p. 91)), and the stream ends the message with it spec §9.4; test/harness-events.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 每个 `message_start` 都会得到一个 `message_end`，即使运行在流式中途被中止。分片只有在有了内容之后才会被提交，而每一条清除分片的内置路径也会追加那条已完成的条目。跨崩溃也是同样的：重新打开时，generation 会把残留的分片变成一条已中止的 `pi.assistant` 条目（生成（p. 91）），流则以此结束那条消息 spec §9.4；`test/harness-events.test.ts`。

nodes.text: Deltas, not values
nodes.zh: 增量，而非值

nodes.text: message_update carries only what changed in the streaming message. Appended text arrives as text_delta or thinking_delta, appended tool arguments as toolcall_delta, and a new content block as a *_start. Any other change resends the whole block or message. Ten commits of a partial cost ten small events, not ten copies spec §9.4.
nodes.zh: `message_update` 只携带流式消息中发生变化的部分。追加的文本以 `text_delta` 或 `thinking_delta` 到达，追加的工具参数以 `toolcall_delta` 到达，新的内容块以 `*_start` 到达。任何其他改动都会重发整个块或整条消息。一个分片的十次提交花费的是十个小事件，而不是十份副本 spec §9.4。

nodes.text: the batch of commit 6 research/capture/agent-events.txt JSON
nodes.zh: 第 6 次提交的那一批。`research/capture/agent-events.txt` JSON

nodes.text: Two view operations become two changes, in order. Usage fields are elided.
nodes.zh: 两个视图操作变成两个 changes，按序排列。usage 字段已省略。

nodes.text: Tool output works the same way. tool_execution_update.output is { set } when the output was replaced, or { trimStart?, append? } when old text was trimmed from the front and new text appended. The capture shows {"set":"1\n"} for the first line and {"append":"2\n"} after. Example 21 rebuilds the output this way:
nodes.zh: 工具输出的工作方式相同。输出被整体替换时，`tool_execution_update.output` 是 `{ set }`；当旧文本从开头被裁掉、新文本被追加时，则是 `{ trimStart?, append? }`。捕获中第一行显示为 `{"set":"1\n"}`，之后是 `{"append":"2\n"}`。示例 21 用这种方式重建输出：

nodes.text: applying output updates test/examples/21-late-join.ts TS
nodes.zh: 应用输出更新。`test/examples/21-late-join.ts` TS

nodes.zh: ? event.output.set

nodes.text: Trimmed from the example. Removed details arrive as null, as when a replay-safe tool restarts (6.4 (p. 94)).
nodes.zh: 示例中已省略。被移除的 details 以 `null` 到达，例如可重放工具重启时（6.4（p. 94））。

nodes.text: Falling behind
nodes.zh: 落后

nodes.text: Like a watch, a stream holds at most 100 undelivered batches. On overflow they are replaced by one snapshot of the newest view, streaming partial included test/harness-events.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 和观察流一样，这条流最多保留 100 个未投递的批次。溢出时，它们会被最新视图的一份快照替换，其中包含流式分片 `test/harness-events.test.ts`。

nodes.text: A snapshot can arrive at any time, not only first. Reset your state to it. Use events for animation and log lines; render the durable picture from the view spec §9.4. Example 19 prints a run with -- events. Do not count on seeing every event; use Submission.wait() for outcomes. One stream covers one conversation. Attach to child conversations separately.
nodes.zh: 快照可能在任何时刻到达，不只是在最初——把你的状态重置为它。事件用于动画和日志行；持久的那份画面要从视图渲染 spec §9.4。示例 19 用 `--events` 打印一次运行。不要指望看到每个事件，结果请用 `Submission.wait()`。一条流只覆盖一个会话，子会话要分别附着。

nodes.text: 8 . 4 The task graph and inspect()
nodes.zh: 8.4 任务图与 `inspect()`

nodes.text: The graph shows every live task as it is committed; inspect() adds what the scheduler would do with each one under the registry you have now.
nodes.zh: 任务图按提交的形态展示每个存活的任务；`inspect()` 补上在你当前这份注册表下调度器会对每个任务做什么。

nodes.text: When a run seems stuck, the cause is usually a task waiting on something the transcript does not show. Two read-only tools show you the tasks. taskGraph() is a live value for a task panel. inspect() is a one-time diagnosis that also says why a task cannot run. After this section you can go from “nothing happens” to the task and the reason.
nodes.zh: 当一次运行看起来卡住时，原因通常是某个任务在等某件记录里看不到的事。有两个只读工具能让你看到这些任务：`taskGraph()` 是给任务面板用的实时值，`inspect()` 是一次性诊断，还会说明某个任务为何跑不起来。读完本节，你就能从「什么都没发生」走到那个任务和那个原因。

nodes.text: A node
nodes.zh: 一个节点

nodes.text: The graph is one value, { tasks }, keyed by task ID. Each node is the stored task record minus its payloads: no input, checkpoint data, outcome data or memos.
nodes.zh: 任务图是一个值 `{ tasks }`，以任务 ID 为键。每个节点是存储的任务记录减去它的载荷：没有 input、检查点数据、结果数据或 memo。

nodes.text: a waiting task in the graph research/capture/extra-p8/inspect-vs-graph.txt JSON
nodes.zh: 任务图中一个处于 `waiting` 的任务。`research/capture/extra-p8/inspect-vs-graph.txt` JSON

nodes.text: No owner key: a conversation owns this task. A node owned by another task carries "owner": <TaskId>. abortRequested turns true in the commit that aborts the task.

cells: pending phase Committed and not yet picked up; also every task that was running when the process died, until it runs again
running phase Picked up by the scheduler in this process
waiting phase, on, policy The stored wait, exactly as committed
nodes.zh: `waiting` 的任务。

cells: completing outcome Finished, holding its outcome until its owned work ends

nodes.text: How the graph moves
nodes.zh: 任务图如何变化

nodes.text: A node appears in the commit that creates its task and disappears in the commit that finishes it. A commit that changes no node, such as a memo write, produces no frame. The graph shows committed facts, so read it with three rules in mind; the figure after them shows the first in a real frame. on is stored — it lists every task the wait named, including finished ones. inspect() tells you which are still live. running means this process — reopening a Harness turns surviving running tasks back into pending (the scheduler (p. 73)). They show as pending until they are picked up again. Live tasks only — once a background subagent’s task finishes, no node lists its conversation. Place later tasks there with the conversation’s owner, which the conversation view also carries (subagents (p. 121)).
nodes.zh: 一个节点在创建其任务的那次提交中出现，在结束它的那次提交中消失。不改变任何节点的提交（例如写一条 memo）不产生任何帧。任务图展示的是已提交的事实，所以要带着三条规则来读它；紧随其后的图展示了第一条规则在一个真实帧中的样子。`on` 是存储的——它列出等待所命名的每个任务，包括已完成的，`inspect()` 告诉你哪些还活着。`running` 指的是本进程——重新打开 Harness 会把仍然存活的 running 任务变回 `pending`（调度器（p. 73）），它们会显示为 `pending` 直到再次被领走。只列存活任务——一旦某个后台子智能体的任务结束，就没有节点再列出它的会话；要把后续任务放到那里，请用该会话的 owner，会话视图也携带它（子智能体（p. 121））。

taskGraph() returns a Chord state; watchTaskGraph() returns a watch with the rules of 8.2 (p. 129). Neither starts scheduling, so a viewer can attach to a paused Harness without starting any work spec §9.5.
nodes.zh: `taskGraph()` 返回一个 Chord 状态；`watchTaskGraph()` 返回一个遵循 8.2（p. 129）规则的观察流。两者都不会启动调度，因此查看者可以附着到一个已暂停的 Harness 上而不开始任何工作 spec §9.5。

nodes.text: inspect(): what the scheduler would do
nodes.zh: `inspect()`：调度器会做什么

nodes.text: harness.inspect(context) writes nothing and runs no task code. It returns scheduling (paused before the first resume(), running, or closing), every live task with its full record and a derived state, and the queued and placed submissions.
nodes.zh: `harness.inspect(context)` 不写任何东西，也不运行任何任务代码。它返回调度状态（在第一次 `resume()` 之前是 `paused`、`running` 或 `closing`）、每个存活任务的完整记录与一个推导出的状态，以及排队中和已放置的提交项。

nodes.text: The graph cannot show “blocked”, because nothing stores it. A blocked task’s record is an ordinary pending or waiting record, and it never finishes on its own. Install a definition that can run it, or abort it: in the capture, abortTask() settles both blocked tasks at once as orphaned, with the blocked reason as the outcome’s reason.
nodes.zh: 任务图无法显示 `blocked`，因为没有任何东西存储它。被阻塞任务的记录就是普通的 `pending` 或 `waiting` 记录，它永远不会自行结束。安装一个能运行它的定义，或者中止它：在捕获中，`abortTask()` 一次性把两个被阻塞的任务以 `orphaned` 了结，并以被阻塞的原因作为结果的 reason。

nodes.text: From “nothing happens” to a reason
nodes.zh: 从「什么都没发生」到一个原因

nodes.text: When a conversation stays busy or a waitForTask() never resolves, call inspect() and check in this order. 1. scheduling is paused. Nothing has called resume() or a call that starts it, such as submit() or waitForIdle(). Read-
nodes.zh: 1. `scheduling` 处于 `paused`：还没有人调用 `resume()`，也没有调用会启动它的东西，比如 `submit()` 或 `waitForIdle()`。只

nodes.text: only viewers never start it.
nodes.zh: 读型查看者永远不会启动它。

nodes.text: 2. A task is blocked. The registry is missing its kind or holds an older version. Fix the install, or abort the task to settle it as
nodes.zh: 2. 某个任务被阻塞：注册表缺少它的 kind，或持有的是一个较旧的版本。修好安装，或者中止该任务，让它以

nodes.text: orphaned (the scheduler (p. 73)).
nodes.zh: `orphaned` 了结（调度器（p. 73））。

nodes.text: 3. A task is waiting. Follow its on to the live tasks and repeat. An aborted task first waits for its owned work (abort, fault and
nodes.zh: 3. 某个任务正在等待：顺着它的 `on` 走到那些存活任务，重复上面的检查。一个已中止的任务会先等待它所拥有的工作（中止、故障与

nodes.text: orphan (p. 80)).
4. A task is completing. Its own work is done and its owned work is not; find the owned nodes in the graph (ownership and
nodes.zh: 4. 某个任务正在收尾：它自己的工作做完了，它所拥有的工作还没有；在任务图中找到那些被拥有的节点（所有权与

nodes.text: structured concurrency (p. 76)).
nodes.zh: 结构化并发（p. 76））。

nodes.text: 5. A task is running. Its code is active. For generations and tools, pi.live in the conversation view shows the attempt, retry
nodes.zh: 5. 某个任务正在运行：它的代码处于活动状态。对生成和工具来说，会话视图中的 `pi.live` 显示这次尝试、重试

nodes.text: wait or tool output (the live document (p. 88)).
nodes.zh: 等待或工具输出（实时文档（p. 88））。

nodes.text: A queued submission waits for the run ahead of it; a placed one belongs to a run that has not answered (6.1 (p. 84)). Finished tasks are not in inspect(); read them with getTask().
nodes.zh: 排队的提交项要等它前面的运行；已放置的提交项属于某个尚未作答的运行（6.1（p. 84））。已完成的任务不在 `inspect()` 里，用 `getTask()` 读取它们。
